filed: 2026-11-10, before any R2 run; cut-offs from E137 results/rules.json by the rule on reports/plans/2026-11-09_plan_reuse-variable-first-test.md (What R2 adds)

cutoffs.source: G: midpoint of Always on found G (0.922475722997802) and the highest found G of Cue, XOR, Table (0.6660544301667705); H: midpoint of the lowest found H of Always on, Cue, Table (0.9607991649923541) and XOR found H (-0.009331731634747431). Both gaps non-empty.

threshold_sources.first_steps_share: proposed by the code writer (plan page, early checks): the first 10 of 300 steps cannot do a quarter of the target KL; judgement
threshold_sources.xor_kl_ratio: proposed by the code writer: KL to the pair at most 0.9 of the half-push reference, the best a model that reads no XOR can do; judgement
threshold_sources.gap_replay_tol: deterministic rebuild of R1 pieces; judgement
threshold_sources.replay_tol: same seeds and code moved from R1; judgement

control.what: stage 0, alone: a zero-step fine-tune (the 67M itself) against M; rebuilt pairs against R1 gaps; moved code repeating R1 Always on G 0.9225 and H 0.976 at in2
control.expected: zero-step gap at the float floor and under floor_gap, so no reading (the do-nothing state cannot pass any label); gaps within gap_replay_tol; replay within replay_tol

label_rule.rule: Per fine-tune with a reading (gap >= floor_gap; for XOR imitators also learned): best found G at k = 4 over sites and starts, best found H over sites. G >= cutoffs.G and H >= cutoffs.H: re-weighted. G < cutoffs.G and H >= cutoffs.H: rewired. H < cutoffs.H: no map found (never read as built: caveat 2). Per imitated pair: the label held by at least 2 of the seeds with a reading; fewer than 2 seeds with a reading, or no label held by 2: no reading.
label_rule.edge_cases: A value exactly at a cut-off counts as at or above. A missing start or site uses what was read; none at all is no reading. G >= cutoff with H < cutoff reads no map found (H is the larger class, so this signals a search fault and is reported as such). The do-nothing state has gap 0, under the floor, so it cannot read any label.
label_rule.blind_to: G and H read only the fine-tune outputs on D (fault 2 on the plan page): a fine-tune that matches its pair exactly must read the pair values whatever is inside it. The H refinement step failed in every R1 site but one, so H is the ridge fit; a low H is a search limit, not absence.

P1.rival: A; B predicts G below cutoffs.G

P4.claim: XOR imitators: no reading (not learned) or no map found; never re-weighted or rewired

P5.claim: Reversion and setter mismatch at the found maps: reported per item beside the pair value from R1; expected reversion below R1 pair value of about 1 at the found site for at least 2 seeds of Always on, because an ordinary fine-tune also changes weights after the site; no label reads them

noise_floor: Spread of one start G at the best site in R1: 0.137 (Always on), 0.082 (Cue); pooled 0.113 (the card). Seed-to-seed spread of the fine-tunes is unmeasured until this run.
stop: If the imitators of Always on, Cue and Table read G and H within 0.1 of each other, the wording gives no reading on real fine-tunes (plan page drop rule); report and stop for the user.
